basic_info.description: Diamond Heights Gem! Discover this cozy studio condominium nestled in one of SF's most distinctive neighborhoods. This original condition studio unit offers a blank canvas for your personal touch, perfect for first-time buyers or investors looking to add value. The efficient floor plan maximizes living space with built-in storage solutions and abundant natural light through large windows showcasing neighborhood views. Recently upgraded association building amenities include a state-of-the-art indoor fitness center, elegant clubhouse for entertaining, a dry sauna, indoor spa and a sparkling heated pool for year-round enjoyment. Ideally located minutes from Glen Canyon Park, with easy access to BART, tech shuttles, and I-280.  Features: Updated building common areas, Controlled access entry, Assigned parking, In-unit laundry hookups, Pet-friendly community, Close to shopping at Diamond Heights Shopping Center. Don't miss this opportunity to create your perfect urban retreat in one of SF's sunniest neighborhoods! Original details ready for your personal vision.
